import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

data = """sepal_length,sepal_width,petal_length,petal_width,species
5.1,3.5,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.9,3.0,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.7,3.2,1.3,0.2,setosa
4.6,3.1,1.5,0.2,setosa
5.0,3.6,1.4,0.2,setosa"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset - Setosa Species Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='sepal_length', y='sepal_width', s=100, color='#2E86AB', ax=axes[0, 0])
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)')
axes[0, 0].grid(alpha=0.3)

sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='petal_length', y='petal_width', s=100, color='#A23B72', ax=axes[0, 1])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)')
axes[0, 1].grid(alpha=0.3)

feature_means = df[['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']].mean()
bars = axes[1, 0].bar(range(len(feature_means)), feature_means.values, color=['#2E86AB', '#A23B72', '#F18F01', '#C73E1D'])
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Measurements', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Length/Width (cm)')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(feature_means)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'])
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                    f'{height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

df_melted = df.melt(var_name='Feature', value_name='Value', 
                     value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'])
sns.boxplot(data=df_melted, x='Feature', y='Value', palette='Set2', ax=axes[1, 1])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Distribution of Measurements', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Feature')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Value (cm)')
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'])
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
